items.title: Lil Uzi and Cuddle Team Leader take over the Stronghold
items.description: Week 2 went live on Sunday 8 November at 9 AM ET (16:00 SAST), a day later than first listed. Lil Uzi Vert is now a boss on the fort's west side (in game the fort is labelled Fortune's Fort) and drops the Exotic Lil' SMG and the Lil' Uzi Vert Jr. Sprite.

items.title: The Megalodon and Buggy arrive
items.description: Epic says Buggy and the Megalodon "crash onto the Island" in week 2 (live 8 November, 16:00 SAST). No source has placed them on the map yet; one unconfirmed report mentions a spot called Brutal Beachhead.

items.title: Crossbones Isle replaces the Override island
items.description: A new skull-and-crossbones map, smaller and with more water. Lobbies drop from 100 to 80 players, and you jump from the Going Merry instead of the Battle Bus.

items.title: 12 new named locations
items.description: Rubber Resort, The Chest, Loot Lagoon, Lil' Uzi's Stronghold, Lantern Landing, Arlong Park, Cursed Cavern, The $.$. Rocky, Windmill Village, Loguetown, Plunder Port and Busy Bay.

items.title: 10 Override locations removed
items.description: Lifty Lodge, Nightmare Neighbourhood, Freaky Fields, Wonkeeland, Golden Grove, Shaken Sanctuary, Cluster Coast, Sunken Shores, Heatwave Harbor and Chopped Shop are gone with the old island.

items.title: Vending Machines out, Gold Bars vaulted
items.description: Chests and floor loot replace Vending Machines across the island, and Gold Bars are vaulted — no buying your loadout this season.

items.title: Cap'n Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto take over Rubber Resort
items.description: Week 3 brings Miku and Teto to the resort on Sunday 15 November (moved from the 14th). The time is assumed to match week 2 (9 AM ET / 16:00 SAST). Their drops aren't announced yet.

items.title: Oscar sails in with his own ship
items.description: Week 4 (Sunday 22 November, moved from the 21st) brings Oscar's ship, the Frenzy Auto Shotgun and Gold Sprites. The time is assumed to match week 2 (16:00 SAST). Where the ship will anchor isn't published yet.
